description: Format-specific script structure templates for AI-assisted content script generation

shortform.description: Optimized for TikTok, Reels, Shorts — typically 15-90 seconds, retention-critical first 1-2 seconds

templates.name: Pattern Interrupt Hook
templates.description: Visual or verbal shock in the first frame to stop the scroll, then rapid payoff.

sections.label: Interrupt
sections.promptGuidance: Unexpected visual, jump cut, or claim that contradicts expectation.

sections.label: Payoff
sections.promptGuidance: No throat-clearing — get straight to the point.

sections.label: Kicker
sections.promptGuidance: End on a line that rewards a rewatch or prompts a comment.

templates.name: Point-of-Contrast
templates.description: Two-sided comparison delivered rapidly — 'this vs that.'

sections.label: Setup
sections.promptGuidance: 'Most people do X. Here's what actually works.'

sections.label: Contrast
sections.purpose: Show the two sides side by side
sections.promptGuidance: Fast cuts or split-screen pacing.

sections.label: Verdict
sections.promptGuidance: One clear takeaway line.

templates.name: POV / Roleplay
templates.description: First-person scenario the viewer projects themselves into.

sections.label: Scenario Tag
sections.promptGuidance: 'POV: you just found out...' on-screen text plus verbal cue.

sections.label: Scene
sections.promptGuidance: Keep dialogue tight and relatable.

sections.label: Punchline/Twist
sections.purpose: Close with payoff or relatable twist
sections.promptGuidance: Should be shareable/quotable.

templates.name: Rapid-Fire Tips
templates.description: Compressed listicle — 3-5 tips delivered at high pace with no filler.

sections.label: Hook
sections.promptGuidance: '3 things I wish I knew before X'

sections.label: Tips
sections.promptGuidance: Repeatable block, 2-4 seconds per tip max.

sections.label: Close
sections.promptGuidance: Follow for more / comment for part 2.

templates.name: Rapid Transformation
templates.description: Before/after shown almost simultaneously for visual proof.

sections.label: Before Flash
sections.promptGuidance: 1-2 seconds max, establish the problem visually.

sections.label: After Reveal
sections.promptGuidance: Hard cut or transition effect for impact.

sections.label: How Tag
sections.promptGuidance: On-screen text: 'Comment X for the full process'.

templates.name: Storytime Compressed
templates.description: Full narrative arc compressed into under a minute.

sections.label: Cliffhanger Hook
sections.purpose: Open at the most dramatic point
sections.promptGuidance: Start in the middle of the action, not the beginning.

sections.label: Quick Rewind
sections.promptGuidance: Keep to 2-3 sentences.

sections.label: Resolution
sections.promptGuidance: Land the ending fast, no lingering.

templates.name: Question Hook
templates.description: Opens with a question the viewer can't resist answering mentally.

sections.label: Question
sections.promptGuidance: Should apply to a broad, specific audience segment.

sections.label: Reveal
sections.promptGuidance: Deliver the insight without padding.

sections.label: Engagement Prompt
sections.promptGuidance: Ask viewers to share their own answer/experience.

templates.name: Green-Screen Reaction/Commentary
templates.description: React to and comment on external content (news, post, video clip).

sections.label: Context Flash
sections.promptGuidance: Brief on-screen source material intro.

sections.label: Your Take
sections.promptGuidance: Be direct and specific — vague takes underperform.

sections.label: Close
sections.promptGuidance: Open-ended prompt for comments.

templates.name: Checklist Flash
templates.description: Visual checklist read aloud with on-screen text ticking off items.

sections.label: Hook
sections.promptGuidance: 'Signs you need to X' or 'Checklist before you Y'

sections.label: Checklist Items
sections.promptGuidance: Repeatable, one short phrase per item.

sections.label: Tally/CTA
sections.promptGuidance: 'How many did you check? Let me know below.'

templates.name: Single Insight Punch
templates.description: One idea, delivered with maximum clarity and no digressions.

sections.label: Claim
sections.promptGuidance: Should be counterintuitive or highly specific.

sections.label: Proof
sections.promptGuidance: A stat, example, or personal result.

sections.label: Restate
sections.promptGuidance: Rephrase the claim as a memorable line.

longform.description: Optimized for YouTube long-form, podcasts, webinars — typically 8-40+ minutes, structured for sustained retention and depth

templates.name: Cold Open Documentary
templates.description: Opens mid-action before titles/intro, then unfolds a full investigative or narrative arc.

sections.label: Cold Open
sections.purpose: Drop viewer into the most compelling moment
sections.promptGuidance: No channel intro yet — pure hook, 15-45 seconds.

sections.label: Title/Premise
sections.purpose: Establish what the video covers and why it matters
sections.promptGuidance: State the promise explicitly.

sections.label: Act 1: Setup
sections.promptGuidance: Introduce key context, people, or timeline.

sections.label: Act 2: Development
sections.promptGuidance: Layer in sub-loops and new information to sustain retention.

sections.label: Act 3: Resolution
sections.promptGuidance: Tie back to the cold open.

sections.label: Outro/CTA
sections.promptGuidance: Subscribe/related video prompt.

templates.name: Deep-Dive Tutorial
templates.description: Comprehensive step-by-step teaching format with context, theory, and practice.

sections.label: Intro
sections.promptGuidance: Preview exactly what viewer will be able to do by the end.

sections.label: Why It Matters
sections.promptGuidance: Brief context on relevance/use cases.

sections.label: Core Concepts
sections.promptGuidance: Break into digestible sub-sections.

sections.label: Step-by-Step Walkthrough
sections.promptGuidance: Repeatable step blocks with expected results.

sections.label: Common Pitfalls
sections.promptGuidance: Preempt viewer frustration/comments.

sections.label: Recap + Next Steps
sections.promptGuidance: Summarize and point to related content.

templates.name: Video Essay
templates.description: Argument-driven format building a thesis through evidence and analysis.

sections.label: Thesis Hook
sections.purpose: State the central argument or question
sections.promptGuidance: Make the claim provocative enough to justify runtime.

sections.label: Context
sections.promptGuidance: Background needed to follow the argument.

sections.label: Supporting Points
sections.promptGuidance: Repeatable — each point with evidence and analysis.

sections.label: Counterpoint/Complication
sections.promptGuidance: Address the strongest opposing view.

sections.label: Conclusion
sections.promptGuidance: Tie back to the hook, leave a resonant final line.

templates.name: Interview / Podcast Flow
templates.description: Conversational structure with segment planning for guest-based long-form.

sections.label: Cold Open Clip
sections.promptGuidance: Pull the most compelling moment from later in the conversation.

sections.label: Guest Intro
sections.promptGuidance: Concise bio tied to why this conversation matters now.

sections.label: Warm-up Questions
sections.promptGuidance: Lower-stakes, personal or origin-story questions.

sections.label: Core Topic Segments
sections.promptGuidance: Repeatable topic blocks with planned follow-up angles.

sections.label: Rapid Fire / Lightning Round
sections.promptGuidance: Optional; short punchy Q&A.

sections.label: Close
sections.promptGuidance: Plug and sign-off.

templates.name: Case Study Breakdown
templates.description: Analyzes a real example (business, project, event) in structured depth.

sections.label: Hook
sections.promptGuidance: Lead with the outcome, not the setup.

sections.label: Background
sections.promptGuidance: Who/what/when necessary for understanding.

sections.label: Strategy/Approach
sections.promptGuidance: Repeatable — one block per key decision or phase.

sections.label: Results
sections.promptGuidance: Use concrete numbers/evidence where possible.

sections.label: Takeaways
sections.promptGuidance: Make it actionable for the viewer's own situation.

templates.name: Vlog Narrative Arc
templates.description: Day-in-the-life or project-based vlog with narrative throughline.

sections.label: Premise
sections.purpose: Establish the goal/frame of the video
sections.promptGuidance: 'Today I'm attempting to X' — set the stakes.

sections.label: Chronological Segments
sections.promptGuidance: Repeatable time/location-based blocks with mini-moments.

sections.label: Obstacle/Turning Point
sections.promptGuidance: Real or highlighted friction point raises stakes.

sections.label: Resolution
sections.promptGuidance: Show final state relative to premise.

sections.label: Reflection/CTA
sections.promptGuidance: Direct-to-camera closing thought.

templates.name: Ranked/Comparative List
templates.description: Extended listicle with deep analysis per item, often ranked or tiered.

sections.label: Hook
sections.promptGuidance: State ranking criteria upfront for credibility.

sections.label: Methodology
sections.promptGuidance: Builds trust before the list starts.

sections.label: Ranked Items
sections.promptGuidance: Repeatable — analysis, pros/cons, or score per item.

sections.label: Final Verdict
sections.promptGuidance: Segment recommendation by viewer type if relevant.

templates.name: Explainer / Educational Deep Dive
templates.description: Breaks down a complex topic layer by layer for general audience understanding.

sections.label: Hook
sections.purpose: Establish why this topic matters now
sections.promptGuidance: Connect to a current event or common misconception.

sections.label: Foundational Concept
sections.promptGuidance: Simplify without dumbing down.

sections.label: Layered Explanation
sections.promptGuidance: Repeatable — each layer builds on the last.

sections.label: Implications
sections.promptGuidance: Answer 'so what?' for the viewer.

sections.label: Summary
sections.promptGuidance: Recap in plain language.

templates.name: In-Depth Review
templates.description: Structured product/service/media review with criteria-based evaluation.

sections.label: Verdict Tease
sections.purpose: Hint at final take without fully revealing it
sections.promptGuidance: Creates a reason to watch through.

sections.label: Overview
sections.promptGuidance: Set baseline facts efficiently.

sections.label: Criteria Breakdown
sections.promptGuidance: Repeatable — one block per evaluation criterion.

sections.label: Comparison
sections.promptGuidance: Reference direct competitors.

sections.label: Final Verdict
sections.promptGuidance: Who should/shouldn't buy or use it.

templates.name: Serialized Narrative Documentary
templates.description: Multi-chapter structure for dense, story-driven long-form (true crime, history, deep investigations).

sections.label: Prologue
sections.promptGuidance: Establish scope and why it deserves this runtime.

sections.label: Chapters
sections.promptGuidance: Repeatable — each chapter has its own mini arc and cliffhanger transition.

sections.label: Climax
sections.promptGuidance: The point the whole narrative has been building toward.

sections.label: Epilogue
sections.promptGuidance: Close threads, offer final perspective.
